title: The Standing
subtitle: A reward behind a scoreboard gate
description: The last payout is gated: the reward carries a `score` condition,
and every path that pays a reward checks its conditions -- the
claim, Claim all, the answer to a choice, and both automatic
modes. A reward whose conditions are unmet is not lost; it stays
unclaimed and is paid the moment they hold.
Ten standing. The objective was created by the vault's first
account and the ledger's close reads it as a task gate; this reads
it as a payout gate, which is the other half of what conditions
